away.summary: The New York Islanders are looking to start their 2026-27 season on a positive note against the Toronto Maple Leafs. They have a projected lineup with Ilya Sorokin confirmed as the starting goalie. Mathew Barzal is expected to miss the game due to a knee injury, but the team is hopeful he will return soon.

home.summary: The Toronto Maple Leafs are looking to bounce back from their 3-2 loss to Montreal after missing the playoffs last season. Anthony Stolarz is confirmed as the starting goalie, and the team has made several roster changes, including acquiring Kirill Marchenko and Darren Raddysh. The team is optimistic about their chances this season with the addition of young talent like Gavin McKenna.
